{"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"NJ Law Against Discrimination: source of lawful income / rent payment (Section 8 vouchers)","requirement":"Landlords may not discriminate in housing based on the source of lawful income or the source of lawful rent or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses. For example, a landlord cannot deny a lawful recipient of a Section 8 HUD voucher the right to rent an apartment based solely on that source of lawful income.","key_value":"Source of lawful income / Section 8 voucher denial prohibited","coverage_conditions":"Applies to the sale or rental of all property, including open land, whether for business or residential purposes.","exemptions":"Rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is occupied by the owner as a residence at the time of rental; rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied by him/her as a residence at the time of rental; preference given to persons of the same religion by a religious organization in sale, lease or rental.","coverage_logic":{"covers":null,"exempt":{"all":[{"field":"units","op":"<=","value":2},{"field":"owner_occupied","op":"==","value":true}]}},"subject":"landlord","interaction":null,"yields_to_local":false,"preempts_local":false,"effective_date":null,"effective_rule":null,"enacted_date":null,"end_date":null,"penalty":null,"citation":"N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq. (NJ Law Against Discrimination)","quoted_span":"The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.","supporting_spans":["This
